Restaurant

Restaurant in El Bedorc (Piera): open days and groups of 8 to 16

La Casa Vella's restaurant, on the ground floor of an 1898 house, opens on set days, each with its own menu. Tables for up to 12 are booked online, and groups of 8 to 16 can ask for a lunch or celebration on another day.

A dining room of stone, wooden beams and an open fire, and a terrace for fine days. From morning coffee to a glass of Penedès wine, and in season, calçots grilled on the terrace.

How to book

  • A table: on open days, online, for groups of up to 12. For more, call +34 667 40 98 59.
  • Groups of 8 to 16 on another day: a birthday, a lunch with friends or a celebration. Tell us what you have in mind with the events form and we will suggest the day, time and menu.

If you are staying at the house, the restaurant is on the same ground floor.
